Absolute row limit for all exports (incl: Absolute row limit for all exports (incl. admin), guarding the database.
Absolute row limit for all exports inclu: Absolute row limit for all exports including admin. Prevents runaway queries from overloading the database.
Capacity of the fallback file-write queu: Capacity of the fallback file-write queue. When full, overflow entries are dropped and the circuit breaker is permanently disabled.

Covers goroutine stop + final DB flush. Recommended 20–25 s to leave room for HTTP shutdown (30 s hard limit)

Dedup commission aggregation across inst: Dedup commission aggregation across instances via shared Redis. Multi-instance MUST enable this to avoid double-counting; single instance can leave it off.
Each field (request/response body and he: Each field (request/response body and headers) is truncated to this size. Content beyond the limit is dropped and marked as truncated.
Expiry (seconds) of the caches on the se: Expiry (seconds) of the caches on the settlement/flush hot path, one per cache. Give them different values so they do not all expire on the same tick — the synchronized expiry causes the periodic flush-latency spike.
Export reached the {{count}}-row limit. Some records were not exported — narrow the time range to export the rest.

If empty, requests and responses of all: If empty, requests and responses of all users are recorded. If filled, only the specified username is recorded.

Leave empty to record all users: Leave empty to record all users
Length of the first auto circuit-open wi: Length of the first auto circuit-open window.
Max attempts before a failed record is w: Max attempts before a failed record is written to the fallback file for manual backfill.
Max byte length of a JSON log line. Long: Max byte length of a JSON log line. Longer lines abort the task and keep the file for retry.

Max rows per export for regular users. Admin exports bypass this but still hit the hard ceiling.
Maximum rows per export for regular user: Maximum rows per export for regular users. Admin exports ignore this setting and are capped at 1,000,000 rows.
Milliseconds the task sleeps after each: Milliseconds the task sleeps after each flush to ease DB write pressure.
Milliseconds to sleep after each batch t: Milliseconds to sleep after each batch to throttle DB load.
Min seconds between exports per user. Re: Min seconds between exports per user. Requests within the cooldown return 429.

Minimum quota units for this currency. J: Minimum quota units for this currency. JPY/KRW are zero-decimal currencies and should use whole-number amounts.
No models available. Please configure yo: No models available. Please configure your groups.
Off (default): retry uses TryLock — skip: Off (default): retry uses TryLock — skips the cycle when the main flush is in progress, eliminating concurrent DB writes to the same tables. On: retry runs concurrently with the main flush for higher retry throughput at the cost of connection-pool contention.
Off: side logic always runs without circ: Off: side logic always runs without circuit protection (no auto-skip on failure). On: consecutive side-effect DB query failures trip the circuit temporarily; auto-recovers after cooldown.
Only covers this ledger path. End-to-end: Only covers this ledger path. End-to-end RPM can bottleneck elsewhere.
Open the circuit after this many consecu: Open the circuit after this many consecutive side-effect failures.
Per-employee tier-level L1 memory cache,: Per-employee tier-level L1 memory cache, prefetched during the settlement flush (seconds). Default 300s.
Per-queue buffer ceiling. Oldest entries: Per-queue buffer ceiling. Oldest entries dropped on overflow to avoid OOM.
Per-queue buffer ceiling. Overflow evict: Per-queue buffer ceiling. Overflow evicts oldest entries to the fallback file; only permanently lost if the fallback queue is also full.
Per-queue ceiling for costRetryQueue and: Per-queue ceiling for costRetryQueue and pairRetryQueue (each capped independently). Overflow writes to the fallback file.
Random ±% spread applied to each cache e: Random ±% spread applied to each cache entry’s TTL so entries expire staggered instead of in one synchronized wave. 0 disables jitter. Default 20%.
Recommended < flush interval ({{sec}} s): Recommended < flush interval ({{sec}} s) — a DB stall at this value blocks the next flush cycle
Record downstream request headers/body a: Record downstream request headers/body and the response headers/body returned to the client for relay requests. Increases database writes significantly.
Records buffered before each batch flush: Records buffered before each batch flush; also the in-memory buffer cap.
Records per outer loop for the settlemen: Records per outer loop for the settlement queue — error-recovery/transaction granularity. Also serves as the fallback for the cost queue when Cost Queue Batch Size is 0.
Register at business.infini.money, creat: Register at business.infini.money, create an API key in the Developer page, and configure the webhook endpoint. Keep all secrets server-side only.
Rows fetched per DB batch. Affects memor: Rows fetched per DB batch. Affects memory usage and DB load.
Should exceed buffer max ({{value}}) to: Should exceed buffer max ({{value}}) to avoid frequent set rebuilds
Skip cost/commission side logic immediat: Skip cost/commission side logic immediately; calculated fallback records go to the log file.

TTL (seconds) of each Redis dedup key. O: TTL (seconds) of each Redis dedup key. Only needs to cover the settlement retry window. Larger = more Redis memory. Only used when "Dedup via Redis" is on.
TTL of each Redis dedup key (seconds), c: TTL of each Redis dedup key (seconds), covering the retry window. Used only when Dedup via Redis is on.

Wake-up interval (seconds) of the retry: Wake-up interval (seconds) of the retry goroutine. Uses TryLock to avoid concurrent DB writes with the main flush: skips the cycle if the main flush is in progress.
